roles.name: Ramp
roles.description: Accelerates mana availability.

roles.name: Mana Fixing
roles.description: Helps produce the colors your deck needs.

roles.name: Card Draw
roles.description: Improves access to cards.

roles.name: Card Selection
roles.description: Filters or organizes available cards.

roles.name: Tutor
roles.description: Searches for a specific card or card type.

roles.name: Removal
roles.description: Answers a threat or permanent.

roles.name: Board Wipe
roles.description: Answers multiple permanents at once.

roles.name: Counterspell
roles.description: Counters spells or abilities.

roles.name: Protection
roles.description: Protects cards or your game plan from interaction.

roles.name: Recursion
roles.description: Recovers cards or permanents from other zones.

roles.name: Graveyard Hate
roles.description: Limits or removes resources from graveyards.

roles.name: Token Generator
roles.description: Creates tokens for other uses or board presence.

roles.name: Sacrifice Outlet
roles.description: Lets you sacrifice permanents as a cost or resource.

roles.name: Enabler
roles.description: Enables a mechanic or game plan.

roles.name: Payoff
roles.description: Turns a mechanic into value or progress toward a win.

roles.name: Engine
roles.description: Generates recurring value when supported.

roles.name: Finisher
roles.description: Helps close out the game.

roles.name: Threat
roles.description: Pressures opponents or demands an answer.

roles.name: Land
roles.description: Provides a mana source or utility land effect.

roles.name: Win Condition
roles.description: Directly contributes to achieving a win condition.
